name: devlog-poster
description: Generate multi-platform devlogs, 4-slide visual cards, and daily or weekly work reports from single or multi-repo git commits.

interface.shortDescription: Turn git commits into multi-platform devlogs, 4-slide visual cards, and daily/weekly work reports
interface.longDescription: Zero-dependency Build-in-Public devlog and work-report workflow supporting single-repo and multi-repo git aggregation, 4 AI-girl persona styles, interactive 5-tab HTML workbench, GitHub releases, Playwright draft saving, image prompt templates, and 6-channel team webhooks.
defaultPrompt: Summarize today's git commits into a multi-platform devlog with 4-slide visual cards and open the preview workbench
